description: List outright (futures) tournaments for a sport, sorted by date: id, name, date, status, league and bookmakerCount (0 = not priced yet). Golf only today: PGA Tour, DP World Tour, LIV Golf and the majors. Call this first, then get_outright_odds with the id. Needs the Outrights add-on: a 403 means the key does not have it, so tell the user the message (it links to where to add it) and do not retry.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated top-level fields to keep on each item (e.g. 'id,home,away,date,status'). Trims large responses.

league.description: League slug: pga-tour, dp-world-tour, liv-golf or majors

maxResults.description: Optional cap on the number of items returned to you (applied after the API call).

status.description: Comma-separated: pending, live, settled, cancelled. Default pending,live

name: list_outrights
title: List outright tournaments
